profiles.name: Browser Tabs
profiles.summary: Tabs, history and zoom for Chrome, Edge and Firefox.
profiles.description: Uses the KnobDeck browser companion extension: open, close and reopen tabs, move between them, go back and forward, zoom, and wheels for bookmarks and history.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Discord Voice
profiles.summary: Mute, deafen, camera, screen share and your voice channels.
profiles.description: Discord voice controls through Discord's local RPC. The channel and soundboard wheels list your servers once the plugin is signed in.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Editing Shortcuts
profiles.summary: Copy, paste, undo, redo, save and find in any app.
profiles.description: The everyday editing shortcuts with the right keys on each OS (Ctrl on Windows and Linux, ⌘ on macOS).
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: File Tools
profiles.summary: Convert, resize and zip the files selected in your file manager.
profiles.description: Works on the selection in Explorer, Finder, Dolphin or Files: image conversion and resizing, PDFs from images, zip and unzip, copy path and batch rename.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: IntelliJ Debugging
profiles.summary: Run, debug and step through code in IntelliJ IDEA and other JetBrains IDEs.
profiles.description: Run, debug, step over/into/out, resume and stop, with Search Everywhere and the terminal. Uses the KnobDeck companion plugin for JetBrains IDEs.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Media Controls
profiles.summary: Play, skip and set the volume of whatever is playing.
profiles.description: System media keys and the master volume. Works with any player that listens to the OS media controls: browsers, Spotify, VLC, music apps.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Philips Hue
profiles.summary: Lights on and off, brightness, warmth and scenes.
profiles.description: Controls all Hue lights (group 0) by default; pick a room or light per item after adding. Needs the Hue Bridge pairing in the plugin's setup.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Power & Session
profiles.summary: Lock, sleep, restart and shut down from one ring.
profiles.description: Session and power actions, plus a screenshot and the system settings. Restart and Shut Down run straight away, so place them with care.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Presenter
profiles.summary: Run a slideshow in PowerPoint, Keynote or Impress.
profiles.description: Start and end the show, move between slides, black or white out the screen and see the slide counter.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Spotify
profiles.summary: Play, skip and see what's playing on Spotify.
profiles.description: Spotify playback with the now-playing title, and the system volume.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Time & Weather
profiles.summary: Clock, timer, stopwatch, world clock and the forecast.
profiles.description: A local clock, a 5-minute timer, a stopwatch, a world clock wheel, the weather now and the next days and hours. Weather uses your approximate location unless you type one.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: VS Code
profiles.summary: Command palette, panels, tasks and debugging for Visual Studio Code.
profiles.description: Drives VS Code through the KnobDeck companion extension (the plugin's setup installs it). Task and debug wheels list what your workspace defines.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Window Snapping
profiles.summary: Snap the focused window to halves and corners, or move it to the next screen.
profiles.description: Halves, quarters, maximize, center and next monitor for the window under focus, through the OS window APIs.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: YouTube Music
profiles.summary: Playback, likes, shuffle and your playlists in YouTube Music Desktop.
profiles.description: For the YouTube Music Desktop app: play, skip, like or dislike, shuffle and repeat, the player's own volume, and wheels for your playlists and the queue.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Code Studio
profiles.summary: VS Code panels, tasks and debugging, with your Claude and Codex limits.
profiles.description: VS Code through its companion extension: palette, files, terminal, tasks, debugging and layout. The AI Stats cells show your Claude and Codex plan limits and usage from their local sign-in files.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Creator Dashboard
profiles.summary: YouTube viewers and studio, Twitch status and OBS recording.
profiles.description: Watch your YouTube live viewers and open YouTube Studio, see whether a Twitch channel is live, and control OBS streaming, recording and chapter markers.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Desktop & Workspace
profiles.summary: Virtual desktops, overview, audio devices and system tools for your OS.
profiles.description: Built only from the OS tools that ship with KnobDeck, so it's ready the moment it's added. Some cells are for one OS (Mission Control on macOS, Task View on Windows, Present Windows on Linux) and are left out elsewhere.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Gaming
profiles.summary: Launch games, talk on Discord and clip the last moments.
profiles.description: A game wheel and Steam pages, Discord mute, deafen and push-to-talk, saving the OBS replay buffer, the system volume and the PC's stats.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Media Deck
profiles.summary: System media keys, volume slider and your music app's controls.
profiles.description: The OS media keys and master volume, with Spotify on the second row. Spotify cells are left out until the plugin is installed with the profile.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Meetings
profiles.summary: Mic mute, audio devices, a meeting timer and quick window moves.
profiles.description: For calls in any app: toggle the microphone at the OS level, switch output and input devices, keep a 25-minute timer and a stopwatch, and snap the call window aside.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: OBS Streaming
profiles.summary: Go live, record, switch scenes and mix audio in OBS Studio.
profiles.description: Stream, record, pause, replay buffer and virtual camera on the top row; four scene buttons and the studio-mode controls; the mic mute and a volume slider for one source. Pick your scenes and audio source in each item after adding. Needs OBS's WebSocket server (Tools → WebSocket Server Settings) and the plugin's setup.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Smart Home
profiles.summary: Home Assistant lights and scenes, plus Elgato key lights.
profiles.description: Pick a Home Assistant entity for each toggle and scene after adding; the wheel lists your lights. The Elgato row controls all your Key Lights.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Streamlabs Live
profiles.summary: Stream, record, replay and scenes in Streamlabs Desktop.
profiles.description: Streamlabs Desktop on Windows and macOS: go live, record, keep a replay buffer and save it, switch scenes and mute or level one audio source.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Twitch Streamer
profiles.summary: OBS, Twitch chat moderation, clips and Discord in one deck.
profiles.description: Go live and record in OBS, drop markers and clips on Twitch, run an ad, switch chat modes, watch your viewer count, and stay muted or deafened on Discord.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: VLC Remote
profiles.summary: Play, seek, skip and fullscreen in VLC.
profiles.description: Talks to VLC's web interface (the plugin's setup turns it on): play and pause, stop, skip, seek, volume and fullscreen, with the play state on the button.
profiles.author: KnobDeck

profiles.name: Voicemod FX
profiles.summary: Voice changer, effects, soundboard and a bleep button.
profiles.description: Voicemod on Windows and macOS: turn the voice changer and background effects on or off, hear yourself, pick a random or favourite voice, and hold to bleep.
profiles.author: KnobDeck
